info.description: CrunchyCode Internship Task 5. Works against localhost and against Railway: change the collection variable baseUrl (http://localhost:8080 or https://YOUR-APP.up.railway.app). Set adminUsername and adminPassword to your ADMIN_USERNAME / ADMIN_PASSWORD. Run the folders top to bottom: Health and Docs, Auth, Driver, Ride, Vehicle Type, Pagination, N+1 Demo, Security.
